    resources = observation.get('resources', [])

    # Prefer moves toward closest resource
    moves = [(0,1), (0,-1), (1,0), (-1,0)]
    target = None

            dy = -1
        if not blocked(px + dx, py + dy):
            return [dx, dy]
        # try alternative directions if blocked

                return [ddx, ddy]
